REVERTED (context contradiction, no GT coverage at this page): the manuscript reads 'السوادين فمن كوش بن حام' — the dark-skinned peoples descend from Kush son of HAM (حام), not Shem (سام). Three signals: (1) the same verse appears twice, both reading حام (p16 l18 prose and p110 l9 verse); (2) the very next verse (p110 l10) names حام again ('نوح على الفلك وحذر الرجال من النساء، في حام وصال'); (3) Shem (سام) is the ancestor of the Semites in this tradition, never of السوادين. The vault's skeleton سام is Adnan's ancestor — the wrong person here. The original review note ('the ancestor') picked the wrong son of Noah.
